name: 4-Panel Picture
description: Write a story about four pictures.

writingFormula.title: 4-Panel Story Formula
points: Write in the past tense (e.g. walked, saw, was).
Write one paragraph for each picture, or join Pictures 2 and 3 together.
Answer both questions in your story.
Add feelings (happy, worried, surprised) to make your story interesting.
End with what the character learnt or how he/she felt.

panelGuide.label: Picture 1 – Beginning
panelGuide.prompt: When? Where? Who? What was he/she doing?

panelGuide.label: Picture 2 – Problem
panelGuide.prompt: What happened? What was the problem?

panelGuide.label: Picture 3 – Action
panelGuide.prompt: What did he/she do? How did he/she feel?

panelGuide.label: Picture 4 – Ending
panelGuide.prompt: What was the result? What did he/she learn?
